queries.compiledQueryString:
select
  occ2,
  soc2_name,
  concat(occ2, ' - ', soc2_name) as soc2_group,
  task_rank,
  cast(task_id as varchar) as task_id,
  task_text,
  rca,
  mentions,
  pct_active_jobs
from nlx.AGGR_NlxMajorOccupationTaskProfile
order by occ2, task_rank
